title: Signals beamed into Benowitz's computer from across the street

tellings.quote: Yes, maybe that happened. I mean that's I the person that told me that was was was Bill.

plain: In the early 1980s in Albuquerque, New Mexico, signals are said to have been beamed into the computer of a man named Benowitz from across the street. A writer named Greg Bishop says it may have happened and that he heard it from a UFO researcher named Bill Moore. Bishop tells it in an episode about how supposed alien contact drove Benowitz to madness.
